Portrait setting: U.A.'s main cafeteria between meal periods. Behind the character, long rows of white tables and stools stretch across a polished floor toward a stainless-steel serving counter with stacked trays; a tall glass wall on one side looks out on green campus lawns, and pale beams cross the high ceiling. No other people. No readable signs or text.
